notes.title: Taxi Life Black Cab Update Out Now | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/b9a7d031b53a43aa8de0ac1c2b470455a8a8f34b.png"]


Hey Drivers!
Today’s a huge day for Taxi Life! Not only are we rolling out a brand new update packed with free content and fixes, but we’re also excited to introduce the first officially licensed vehicle in the game! Let’s dive into what’s new.


Free Content Update


Gameplay improvements: Mission triggers now appear dynamically as you drive, making passenger pick-ups seamless and natural.
[previewyoutube="Rv7GUnujchs;full"][/previewyoutube]


Country Flags: Show off your pride. Decorate your taxi with a variety of national flags completely free.
[previewyoutube="C7XKo42FAPQ;full"][/previewyoutube]


New DLC: The LEVC


The iconic Black Cab has officially arrived in Barcelona and here's what makes it unique!



Right-Hand Drive: For the first time in Taxi Life, experience driving from the right side of the cab.

Electric Power: Another EV joins your fleet don’t forget to recharge!

Extra Luggage Space: No front passenger seat means more room for baggage.

A London Classic: Built in the UK, now seen in Barcelona.



You can buy the new LEVC DLC today!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3854360/Taxi_Life_A_City_Driving_Simulator__Black_Cab/"][/dynamiclink]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/188c86487301a03ab965f0aa52fb2e6f76c23379.gif"]



Fixes & Improvements

Gameplay Improvements

Added quick recharging via the radial menu.

Fixed bug where passengers only spawned once every 24 hours.

Added periodic contextual tutorial notifications.

Full Repair is now properly permanent, even after customizing your car.

Fixed abnormally large tip amounts appearing in certain challenges.

Vehicles

Black Cab (LEVC TX / Car 10)

Added official LEVC TX DLC vehicle.

Fixed invisible clients inside the cab.

Fixed driver’s hands clipping into steering wheel.

Emergency light now interactable in first-person.

Removed roof sign and updated materials.

Added missing taxi text.

Default color set to black.

Added proper DLC store button and package support for PS5/XSX.

Other Vehicle Fixes

Fixed license plates changing when entering/exiting garage.

Steering wheel colors now update correctly in the garage.

Fixed side mirror behavior during package delivery cutscenes.

Rear light materials for Car 8 now behave correctly.

Fixed tourist trigger zone task colors.



Fixed multiple parade-related issues (AI cars blocking, vehicle stuck ramps).

Fixed access to certain cars in Placa Catalunya.

UI & UX

Radial Menu improvements:

Added dead zone support for controllers.

Radial Menu now auto-closes at pickup spots.

Fixed map filters not saving correctly in cloud saves.

Fixed overlapping passenger info text in Spanish.

Fixed debug text appearing in passenger info ("Carrer de L'Escar").

Hovered client info no longer stays visible after pickup.

Photo Mode camera behavior improved.

AI & NPCs

Fixed clients waving indefinitely after nearby pickups.

Fixed clients still waving after leaving the zone.

Fixed NPCs in parades not despawning after events.

Improved collision handling with waving clients.

Fixed AI car horns looping infinitely.

Fixed AI cars driving into parades at intersections.

Fixed camera clipping into player car during collisions.

Sound & SFX

Fixed missing SFX when switching tabs with keyboard.

Fixed cleaning/repair/refuel sounds continuing when changing tabs.

Localization

Fixed overlapping text in Spanish passenger info.

General localization updates across languages.

Save System

DLC car prices now display correctly in cloud saves.

Map filters now save and load properly.

Design & Systems

Employees now correctly take sick days.

Fixed acceleration input stacking during end-of-course animations.

Art & Animation

Fixed roof sign visuals and material inconsistencies.

Fixed driver animations during cargo cutscenes.

Fixed access issues for the Victoris car.

Resolved missing SFX after settings changes.


Thank you! 

We appreciate each and everyone one of our community members in helping us with bug reporting and improving Taxi Life. We encourage you to continue your support by giving us feedback in our discord channel and stay up to date with the latest news from our teams by following us everywhere.


Check out our last livestream to see our showcase of the patch. We hope you enjoy the update! 


Hasta la próxima,



Mike

Simteract Community Manager

notes.title: A London Classic Rolls Into Barcelona
notes.content:
Hey Drivers!
We’re excited to officially reveal the first licensed vehicle coming to Taxi Life and it’s one many of you will instantly recognize…  Meet the LEVC, the iconic London electric taxi, now making its debut on the streets of Barcelona!


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/24adac4352534eb202ac32a2a9417e8aa3e95120.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/d45b9b26d554a19ff213702d6979846d159a55c9.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/f8a014e279f8fca400f37d8159ae0663e3e650b5.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/f0052742c8f30517da29fb4220d2d662452920e4.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/94e9cd8a377366a8be1bbd24b5b37ac006ae49b5.png"][/carousel]

What Makes the LEVC Special?


Right-Hand Drive 

For the first time in Taxi Life, you’ll be driving from the right side of the cab. UK drivers, this one’s for you.

Electric Power 

Another electric vehicle joins the Taxi Life fleet. Don't forget to charge before your shift!

No Passenger Seat (More Room for Luggage!)

Unlike most vehicles, the LEVC replaces the traditional front passenger seat with extra luggage space, making it the perfect workhorse for taxi drivers. Why stash bags in the trunk when you can load them conveniently right beside you?

Built in the UK, Seen Around the World 

Manufactured in England and traditionally found cruising through the streets of London, the LEVC is now showing up in cities like Barcelona and now it’s your turn to drive it.


Why It Matters
The LEVC marks a major milestone: it’s the first officially licensed vehicle added to Taxi Life. We can’t wait for you to get behind the wheel of this modern classic and experience a new level of real-world immersion in the game.


Available DLC on September 18th
You’ll be able to purchase the LEVC vehicle as part of the upcoming DLC, launching alongside our next free update on September 18th across all platforms! And yes… we’ll be showing it off during our next livestream!  Make sure you’re following us on socials so you don’t miss it!


Hasta la próxima,

Mike 

Simteract Community Manager

Make sure you keep them interested, as you will have to balance their interest bar along with driving safely and maintaining their patience as well.

This one’s all about putting your driving and tour guide skills to the test.

UI & Gameplay

Fixed an issue where the game could freeze after multiple save reloads

Package icons from old deliveries no longer show up in new jobs

Fixed the tip amount for completed taxi jobs—it now reflects your performance

Experience and money now correctly saved by autosave after finishing a course

Mouse/keyboard inputs now behave correctly when switching during Pause Menu

Fixed issues with photo mode and driver visibility in FPP

Map & Navigation

Improved the look of curved roads on the minimap

Fixed issues with invisible collisions during parade events

Blocked access to unintended areas like the opening near Plaça de Ramon Berenguer el Gran

AI & Events

notes.title: Taxi Life: Delivery Driver DLC OUT NOW
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/3fae04085a887e1b3959e9f9be7046e05703fc16.png

Drivers! 

In today's update, you’ll be able to explore the streets of Barcelona with the Delivery Driver DLC. This includes a new way to make money in Taxi Life along with normal jobs, company management and now package delivery. We talked a bit in our previous blog and did a deep dive on some of the main features of this update so, if you missed that check it out! 

New Vehicle: The Victoris
The Delivery Driver DLC includes a new vehicle called the Victoris. It’s a powerful pickup ready to tackle package deliveries with ease. No worries, you’ll still be able to pick up regular passengers also. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/1b6f5daf934307102fe89778d6859c24b1d7c50c.png
(funfact: the Victoris was named after our 3D Artist,”Victor” - Shoutouts to Victor!)

New Game Mode: Delivery Driver
In this new game mode, you'll be able to pull up to any one of the new warehouse icons on the map. From there, you’ll be faced with a UI showcasing the deliveries. You’ll be able to pick and choose which deliveries to take based on the size of your vehicle. So for example, the Victoris will be able to hold 8 packages as compared to smaller vehicles which will hold less. We talked a lot about this and even answered some questions about it during our last livestream, so feel free to check it out! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/6c69a57279301d2a2145d126b218760e2e77be3e.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384710/Taxi_Life_A_City_Driving_Simulator__Delivery_Driver/

Now it’s time to get to the nitty gritty. We have a good amount of actual patch notes to get through. So lets go ahead and take a look at some of the bug fixes and changes we made:

AI & World Adjustments

 Pedestrian spawn rate slider added—so you can finally decide how many jaywalkers you want to deal with.
 Parallax vehicles now properly break and get dirty instead of remaining pristine after collisions
 Fixed an issue where passengers would appear below Parallax cars instead of inside them (we promise, no ghost passengers!)
 Various small spoiler adjustments on certain vehicles
 Stability & Bug Fixes
 Fixed a crash when resetting perks
 Addressed a bug where dialogues could stop working after canceling a Challenge
 Mouse steering no longer interferes with the lean keybind
 Fixed a bug where the game could freeze after multiple save reloads
 Fixed issues with engine behavior in simulation + clutch mode


Other Additions

 Added version number to the main menu widget
 Various AI pedestrian logic tweaks (yes, fewer suicidal pedestrians)
 Optimized backend FMOD updates for better audio performance
 Fixes to in-cabin interactive panels for multiple languages 
 Fixes to clock display
 Fixes to impact detection for AI vehicles
 Fixes to experience bar calculations


Thank you! 
Thanks for your continued support for Taxi Life. It’s great to see the community grow around our game and we’re looking forward to releasing more content for you. Make sure to join our official Discord channel and stay up to date on the latest news coming from our teams on socials! 

See you in Barcelona! 

The Simteract Team

notes.title: Taxi Life Announcement: Next Patch + DLC Info
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/5a97878cd5cb06dc3a8d151237212e654bed9116.png

Hello Drivers, 

We hope the new year has you off to a great start and you’re ready to come along with us for the ride to see what’s next to come for Taxi Life. In this post, we’ll be talking about some dates, what you can expect in the next patch as well as the new DLC that comes along with it. Without further adieu, let’s dive right in. 

Release Date + DLC info
We’re excited to announce that the next patch is scheduled for release on February 13, 2025. This update will introduce a brand-new DLC available across all platforms.

New Game Mode: Delivery Driver
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/26adad33606dc0e62f0f174b5f2673230f247ae3.png
We did tease this a little bit on our social media and the eagle eye’d of you noticed that there is a new icon on the map. When you go to this icon, you’ll start the new cargo delivery mode where you’ll be timed on delivering packages to points on the map. So you’ll have to be quick, but safe.

Many of you have already mastered Taxi Life by completing it 100%, and we’re excited to introduce something fresh for you!

With the brand-new DLC, players can dive into the "Delivery Driver" game mode, where the challenge is to deliver packages safely and in the best condition (or at least try) avoiding damage along the way. New players, on the other hand, will have additional objectives to tackle while immersing themselves in the vibrant streets of Barcelona.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/56ceae68dda64d5f64648a73acb13aa804043e40.png

And what better way to explore the city than with a brand-new ride? The Victoris pick-up truck is here, ready to take on the demands of your delivery missions with style and efficiency. Get ready to experience Taxi Life like never before!

New Vehicle: Victoris
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/9863705218a149b22044b72824f8fdfbed974116.png
We’ve added a new pick-up truck into the game called the Victoris. Spacious, powerful and it has a cargo bed in the back making it ideal for picking up packages in the new delivery mode. Doesn’t mean that you can't pick up passengers in this beast also. But remember, with great power comes great responsibility. 

Fixes and Improvements

AI Pedestrian

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/a019bb56709d40c011ad1d51d29c5eb1d3276807.png

Yes, we know. AI pedestrians have been a pain in the…you know what. 

We tried our best to improve them in previous patches and although we did see some good progress with the help of the community on making the AI pedestrians not try to kill themselves or worse…cause players to get ticketed. We decided that it would be a good idea to give you the option to turn the pedestrians completely off by a slider in the settings menu. 

You can set that switch to 0 and BOOM….you are now living in a post apocalyptic world where Taxi’s have taken over and humans have gone extinct.

Other Changes and Improvements

Alongside those additions mentioned above, you can expect a good amount of bug fixes for some stuff that you guys have been asking us to fix for months now. So we wanted to thank you for your patience and support throughout this time.  

You can expect fixes to the acceleration and engine behavior when using the throttle and shifting between gears. We’ll have more info on that in the patch notes on release day. 

We actually are testing out a new bug reporting system on our Discord that we hope will streamline the process of reporting bugs and make it easier for our team to organize and prioritize reports, while giving you guys transparency and regular updates on the status of them. So if you encountered a bug while playing Taxi Life, join our Discord channel and let us know what you think of the new system.

Thank you! 

Thanks again for being a part of the Taxi Life community. You guys motivate us to keep doing what we’re doing on a daily basis and we hope you can come along with us to see what we have in store for the rest of the year. 

Ens veiem a Barcelona,

The Simteract Team

notes.title: Patch 5 | OUT NOW!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/2e064219297fbb154129b9da8d599440bebd1b58.png

Hello Drivers, 

The day has arrived. The long awaited patch 5 is finally out and we’re happy to see all the hype surrounding it. If you want more details like videos and a deeper explanation of each feature we added we talked about everything in our previous blog here. Otherwise, let's dive into the notes.


NEW FEATURES

Photo Mode - We added a photo mode so our players can take dope screenshots of their pimped out vehicles like Xzibit. You can adjust the temperature, zoom levels, film grain and much more. Have fun! 

Mouse steering - A long requested accessibility feature. This will allow players to use the mouse to more precisely steer the vehicle when playing with a mouse + keyboard. 

Alternative quicklook - Now, an alternative quicklook mode will be introduced:

Quick Look OFF
Right stick for free look.
LB + right stick for quick look.

Quick Look On
Right stick for a quick look.
LB + right stick for free look.

You'll be able to find this switch in the settings menu and choose which style fits you best.

Hide the HUD + Center DOT - You can access this new feature in the System Settings > Video > Presence of HUD

Go back to Practice mode -  Players that want to brush up on their driving skills in a safe and non-chaotic environment can now go back into the driving school and do so. Feel free to master those 3 point turns, without the intensity of other drivers honking at you.


Bug Fixes

Pedestrians

 Pedestrian walking loops at narrow crossroads in two districts have been fixed.
 Pedestrians now stop at red lights when crossing in certain districts.
 Pedestrians no longer pass through trees next to the Umbracle.

notes.content:

Summer is almost over, but things are just heating up for Taxi Life. We’re working hard on bringing the biggest patch to date (this also includes consoles + steering wheels) and we’re here to show you guys some of the things you can expect. So let's dive in to see what you can expect in patch #5.

Photo Mode
[previewyoutube=qIZ38ZD4BH8;full][/previewyoutube]

We heard so many of our players say how awesome it would be to have a photo mode and take in all of the glorious scenes you experience while driving through the city of Barcelona. Now you’ll be able to take all the glamor shots of your pimped out people carrier that you need. 

Need more practice? Go back to school!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/0c701bec25c00858331950f3c06416552f864e9c.png
Sometimes the streets of Barcelona can be tough for a Taxi driver. So why not give you the opportunity to go back and practice some of your parking skills? Or maybe you're having issues with doing a 3 point turn? Or MAYBE you just want to run over some traffic cones. Regardless, players will be able to go back to driving school to polish up their driving skills for the real world (in Taxi Life).

Mouse Steering
[previewyoutube=duMOw0smZ2M;full][/previewyoutube]
Mouse steering is something that has been mentioned by our players many times. For some it's an accessibility feature, for others it could just be simply a better way to drive and maneuver the car. With the new mouse steering feature, you’ll be able to find this option in the settings menu and enable or disable it. 

Option to hide the HUD and center dot
We know that for a lot of players in our Discord, Steam and beyond the center dot can be more of a distraction rather than being helpful. So we’re giving you the option to disable it and along with that, the option to disable the HUD as well. We understand that players just want that completely immersive experience just driving around the city, with nothing else on the screen but the beautiful landscape and winding streets, this is for you those players!  You can access these options in the System settings > Video > Presence of HUD

Alternative quick look features
The quick look feature remains unchanged but its accessibility is being improved. Previously, players had to press LB to use quick looks, which was fine, but not ideal for those who don’t need to look around often but rely heavily on quick looks (e.g., glancing left or right while turning).

Now, an alternative mode will be introduced:

Quick Look OFF
Right stick for free look.
LB + right stick for quick look.

Quick Look On
Right stick for a quick look.
LB + right stick for free look.

You'll be able to find this switch in the settings menu and choose which style fits you best. 

Various bug fixes
Invisible curbs, peds not behaving how they’re supposed to (still) should also get a nice polish up for the next patch as well. We’re always working on making the game better with the feedback of the community so keep it coming - we’re always listening. 

Thanks for being with us
We wanted to finish off with another big thanks to the community. Without you guys we wouldn’t be in the position we are in today with a 72% positive rating on Steam and with that, the game is also 35% off right now!

Also, we wanted to let our community know that we are in the final phases of QA testing, fixing, debugging and patching. Our team is working hard on getting this out ASAP but we need to be thorough as we want our drivers to have the best experience possible on all platforms when patch #5 launches. 

As for the future of the game, expect more after patch 5. DLC and more vehicles are being worked on as we speak. More info on that after this patch when it launches.

It’s been awhile since we shared information on what we’re working on besides steering wheels for consoles and we thought it would be a good idea to let you guys know what we’re working on for the next patch. Speed Limit Sign on the Minimap
We’ve added speed limit signs to the minimap, helping you stay within legal limits as you navigate the streets of Barcelona. It should help players better identify how fast they should be going on a given street that they’re on.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/3b214b514ee914fd65c8b55715d20c40e277b82f.png

Hello Drivers, 

Here we are. Taxi Life was released a week ago today.

First of all, we'd like to thank you for all your support and feedback to improve the game. Reading your feedback, your kind messages and your encouragement has given us a lot of fuel for this first week. We are glad to read that many of you are enjoying driving in Barcelona! 

Now, let's get straight to the point.

We are aware that you're interested in what is going on next in Taxi Life. And in this News, we want to share with you how our first week was for the team, and what’s coming in the future of Taxi Life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/6325dcc083cb4334f2d19d18f15044213b3b5bd1.png

Driving Wheel:

The main feedback we've received is that there aren't enough steering wheels compatible with the game. During the development of Taxi Life we worked with the driving wheels that were available for us. There are a lot of models out there, and it takes a lot of time to make every single driving wheel compatible with the game. It's not an excuse, but this was our situation.

We really want to expand this list, and improve some actual driving wheels. We have a step-by-step plan that we are polishing right now and should let you know in more detail soon how it will look. In parallel we need to fix other issues you're already experiencing in-game.

AI issues:

Recreating the life of a real city was a challenge for us. We think we've succeeded in modeling a part of the city of Barcelona. But our AI is a complex system and there’s a lot of randomization. We tested it as carefully as we could and believed that balance would work. Now we see there’s still work to do. 

At the moment, we're working on improving the behavior of the cars. For example we know some cars can run into the back of your car quite randomly. It can happen to you once every five minutes, but it can also never happen to you. Our second piece of AI work focuses on pedestrians. Especially those who use crosswalks too often and can block the player. 

More details bellow.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/c3727dd3775fc55b43b7404a311dcbe58403bea9.png

Performance issues & bugs:

Performance issues are also a challenge for us. We're getting feedback that on some high-end PC’s the game runs very badly, and on others that, and I quote, "are several year old potatoes", the game runs very well.

So we're going to work on that. We want to provide a good Taxi Life experience to many players, and we understand that stuttering and frame loss are not fun and can be frustrating.

More content?

To be completely transparent, we've got lots of ideas, and you've shared with us some great ideas for improving the game as well. But for the moment, it's still a bit early to think about what we're going to add to the game. So for now, we encourage the community to keep the ideas and feedback coming and please know that we’re always reading everything.

We'd like to add more cars, expand the map, add more features, cities etc... but we need to stay focused on improving what's already there, rather than ignoring the problems and adding content just to hide the dust under the carpet.

Rest assured, as soon as we’re ready to talk about what's next for Taxi Life, we will communicate it, no doubt. 

Oh, and we'll add NPC taxis driving around the city in the next patch upon community's request!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1351240/Taxi_Life_A_City_Driving_Simulator/

Let's stop talking, what's going to happen in the next few weeks?

Our IDEAL plan is to release a patch every one or two weeks or so until Taxi Life reaches a standard that satisfies you, the players. Over the next few days, we will be releasing patches to correct bugs and improve AI. This is our plan for the patches that will be arriving shortly.

At the time of writing, a patch is being tested by our quality assurance (QA) team for validation before going live in a few days. 

To give you more details, we decreased the number of random collisions between AI vehicles (or with your car). We've also reduced the amount of pedestrians a little bit and some of the crossings shouldn't be problematic anymore.

For the past week we've been making lists of the most popular steering wheel models to prioritize which ones we're going to add. We'll try to add a little at a time.

Finally, a quick word for our console players; We are still working on the performance issues you have on Playstation 5. We have a solution that is currently being tested by our QA, it should arrive very soon.

Once again, thank you for your support!

notes.title: FAQ Taxi Life: A Driving Simulator
notes.content:
Hello Drivers, 

Have a look at the Frequently Asked Questions before posting in the forums, you might find your answer here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/f80fe43091c6cc4df7bf3515b4cda0d640a9a235.png

 GENERAL
Should I play with a controller, a wheel, or a keyboard and a mouse? 
As for most driving games, we recommend to play with either a controller or a compatible steering wheel for optimum comfort. However, the game can also be played with a keyboard and a mouse. 

Where can I find information on which controllers or driving wheels are compatible?
Driving wheels are compatible on PC. You can check the full list here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1351240/view/4143945532210378079?l=english

Is Taxi Life compatible with Steam Deck?
Yes, Taxi Life is playable on Steam Deck. 

Is there a physical version of the game available?
Yes, on all the platforms. Check with your local retailer if they are distributing it. 

Can I skip the tutorial?
Yes, you can. But we don't recommend it!

Is Taxi Life multiplayer?
No, Taxi Life was designed as a solo game.

How long does the game last?
It depends on your game style but generally, it takes around 30 hours to unlock all cars, monuments and skills. However, there is no actual ending and you can play indefinitely. 

How do I change the player's view?
You can change the camera by pressing D-pad up on the gampad or C on the keyboard.

Will there be additional content?
Two DLCs are currently available: the VIP Vintage Convertible Car and the Supporter Pack. We will let players know if any new DLCs is planned in the future. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/c3727dd3775fc55b43b7404a311dcbe58403bea9.png

GAMEPLAY
Can I customize my character?
When creating a new career, you can choose your main character appearance among 4 choices. Once you've chosen a character, you can't change it afterwards. 

Is there any impact if I'm mean to my passengers? Nice?
Depending on you being nice or rude, you get higher or lower tips at the end of the ride. Your behaviour also impacts the XP you get and the patience level of the client, which stops the ride when reaching 0.

Do customer ratings have an impact?
Customer ratings have an impact on your tip, but not on future courses.

What happens if I don't drop off the client on time?
The mission is failed and you don't get money or XP. However, you're not fined for this.

Do I have to have a customer all the time, or can I just drive around town/explore?
You can drive around Barcelona as long as you like without a customer, so feel free to explore all the landing marks!

How can I change my driving style? What driving modes are available?
Four driving modes are available: arcade, semi-arcade, simulation and simulation+clutch. 

- Arcade mode: no gears changes and brake is changed to revers gear whenever needed
- Semi-simulation: player has to use gears changes button in scope R-N-D, independently of the type of gear box in the car
- Simulation: the player has to use the gearbox as it works in the car
- Simulation + clutch mode: similar to simulation, but the player has to use clutch

Can I play even if I don't know how to drive in real life? Can I drive even if I don't have a European driving license?
No need for a driving licence to play Taxi Life! At the start, you're introduced to the game through a driving school where all the main controls and car maneuvers are explained. As for the main rules, here are the ones you should keep in mind:
- Keep your speed equal or below each area's speeding limit (50km/h most of the time, 30km/h, 70km/h or 90km/h when indicated by a pannel)
- Signal right or left before turning right or left  
- Stop before red lights 
- Don't drive against the flow
- Don't drive on the pavement

How do I gain experience in the game?
By driving according to the road rules, finding collectables and taking clients.

Where do I find the challenges?
They are spread out across the map in different places. Look for the trophy icons!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/6325dcc083cb4334f2d19d18f15044213b3b5bd1.png

CARS
Where can I buy and customize cars? 
You can buy, sell and customize cars in the garage. You can also change their parts and perform their maintenance (refuel, fix and clean). 

Are there real car brands? 
All the car brands in Taxi Life are fictional. 

If the car is too damaged, what should I do?
Repair it by driving to a garage or by using the emergency section of the radial menu and selecting to tow to the garage.

What is the price of gasoline in Taxi Life? Are there any fluctuations?
The price is randomized every day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/52f0a1ac00e8feec9496fbf33ccb07b393bc40d6.png

CITY
Is the entire city of Barcelona reproduced in the game?
A large part of Barcelona has been reproduced in 1:1 scale, but not the whole city. Also note that you will recognize the streets, buildings layout, monuments, landmarks… but that not all small buildings have been exactly reproduced - for example, you may not find your local shops or restaurants. Some details have also been altered for gameplay purpose, such as gas station locations, and all the street art you see in the game is fictional.

What happens if I do not respect the law?
If you disobey the law and you're caught by a road radar or a spotted by a patrolling police car, you'll immedialy receive a fine. The only exception to this rule is during challenges in which clients ask you to drive as fast as possible, in which case you won't receive a fine for the duration of the mission. 

What are the speed limits in the game?
Like in a majority of cities, the speed limit is ususally 50 kmph, but you will also find places where the limitation becomes either 30 kmph, 70 kmph, or 90 kmph.  

Can we run over pedestrians?
You can but you won't see the result - once you touch a pedestrian with your car, a black screen appears and you get seriously fined.

Is it normal for cars and pedestrians not to always respect the law?
Just like in real life, other cars and pedestrians might disobey the law from time to time. Watch out if a pedestrian crosses outside crosswalks!

Can we perform drifts?
You can but it's not easy, and definitely not recommended if a police car is around!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/2f065aff5125395caeea2fb234ffac261cfe428f.png

MANAGEMENT
Where can I manage my business?
You have to get into a garage and go to the management panel. Once you buy your first car, you'll be able to recruit employees and assign them a car, a shift and a location. There is no limit to the number of employees you can hire. 

Does assigning my employee to a neighborhood have an impact? What about assigning them to a specific car?
Yes, assigning an employee to a neighborhood has an impact: different neighborhood have different prices in different hours. Some drivers also have perks and/or drawbacks which change their price depending on the car they drive.

How can I get my employees to have fewer accidents, keep their cars clean, and work harder?
Drivers with specific perks behave and perform better, and drawbacks work opposite. After a few hours or playing, the driver will learn and both their perk and drawback will evolve.

Why aren't my employees bringing in any money for the business?
You need to let the time pass naturally while you're on the streets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/d49811bf8a95ff2aabfffd6e46e1b7fba1c90f4f.jpg

SUPPORT
Where can I get help if I have an issue?
To get help and report any issues you have encountered reach our support here: https://taxi-life.zendesk.com/hc/en-gb

How do I change my key bindings?
You can change your key bindinds in System settings > Controls.

If I'm stuck, what should I do? What if I run out of money?
If you get stuck on the road, you can use the radial menu to go to the emergency section and restore the car to the road. You cannot get bankrupt in the game: if you have less than 0 money, you will not be able to buy new cars and parts, but you will be able to refuel, repair and drive your car. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1351240/Taxi_Life_A_City_Driving_Simulator/

Now we mentioned this in the past about the skill tree being added into the game, and now, it’s ready to be used. New Car

Development is never a straight path. When one aspect of the game improves, another can become unstable. While some of these issues have been addressed, we wanted to share a few things that we improved upon since last time.

notes.title: Urban Venture Developer Blog #4
notes.content:
Hello drivers! 

Welcome to our fourth blog post for Urban Venture! Once again, we are happy to show our community some of the things we've added and have been working on since our last update. Today, we’re going to be talking about the in-game garage, new features for TrafficAI, as well as a new and improved night mode! 

Before we get into the blog post, I wanted to remind everyone that everything you’re about to read/see is subject to change. Game development is a process, and everything can be changed or iterated upon at a moments notice. 

With that in mind: I know you are all excited to see what we got in store this time around, so without further adieu, let's get into it! 


The Garage

The garage  is going to be one of the central gameplay features of Urban Venture. Everyone likes pictures or videos of WIP stuff in game development, right? So, take a gander at this beauty: 

[previewyoutube=zlqqIjXYAlw;full][/previewyoutube]

The main purpose of the garage will be for players to customize, repair, refuel and browse their fleet of vehicles. Car parameters such as your vehicles' endurance levels, tire pressure, and engine durability will factor into its performance. You will also be able to buy and sell your cars from here, as well other functions we are still working on. The placement of the garage is still something that we are figuring out where to put in the game, currently what you see in the video is a placeholder location for now. 

Once we have some more progress made on the garage, we will share more, so stay tuned! 


TrafficAI Features

TrafficAI™ is a term that we have thrown around in previous blog posts here and there - and it’s something that we think people will be excited over when they get a chance to play the game! When the game has driving at its core, we think players will really notice and appreciate our dedication to our traffic models to help with proper immersion.

For those that are reading this article for the first time, let me explain what TrafficAI™ is. TrafficAI™ is a  technology that we developed in-house to teach real-life autonomous vehicles to learn how to drive. So, we figured, hell, why don’t we put that in our next game, and that’s exactly what we did. We even made some improvements...

[previewyoutube=Tlga2MjN6Fo;full][/previewyoutube]



 AI’s stopped honking on red lights (believe us, this was a huge problem when all you could hear is honking throughout the entire game)

 Honking is now based by the AI driver’s frustration.

 Honking is now activated once AI is emergency braking.

 The AI are now acting slower on the arcs – no more traffic jams at roundabouts and turns! (This is something that we noticed was a problem when the AI drivers were making moves at roundabouts. The cars would basically get stuck causing humongous traffic jams. Now this shouldn’t be an issue)

 AI density reacts to the day cycle – there are more traffic jams in the morning and afternoon, much less during the nights 



For us, the last point is all about player immersion once again. We want the player to experience full day and night cycles on the roads in the game, as you would in real life. The same goes with our dynamic weather system which will influence to how the world around the player reacts. When it rains, there will be less people on the street and braking distance is increased, cars might drive slower and so on. 

Nighttime Improvement


Nighttime in Urban Venture is a tricky topic. When we started implementing a day/night cycle, we had the challenge of illuminating the roads with streetlights.  At first, it was very dark, like too dark! We also had to adjust the traffic flow at night so there could be less cars. 

In the pictures below, you can see some before and after examples of light density on the streets. Nighttime driving can bring its own set of challenges in any video game, but in Urban Venture, we wanted to bring as close to an authentic experience as driving in real-life nighttime as possible. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/b2e9f0b8e2251d85dad4faf6ab6e62e0c74983a4.png

THANK YOU!


That’s about all from our side! We hope you’re enjoying our monthly Dev Blog updates and if you have any feedback to give about how we’re running things here please don’t hesitate to leave a comment under the post! 

Make sure to join our official Discord channel, and follow the development process on socials! 

See you all in the next one! 

Hasta La Próxima,

Mike 
Simteract Community Manager

notes.title: Urban Venture Dev Blog #3
notes.content:
Hello Drivers!

We’re back with another edition of our developer blog! We hope you have been enjoying the things we have been talking about up until this point and we will have much more to share in the future. If you’re new here, don’t forget to join our Discord channel to stay up to date with the latest news from our team regarding Urban Venture as well as our other projects!

As a note, everything mentioned in this blog is subject to change as the game is still a work-in-progress. That means anything we share is not set in stone, and later down the line it could get iterated upon, removed, or changed completely! 

With that in mind, let’s get into it.

Unique Assets

As you know, creating a city at a 1:1 scale can be challenging as everything must be as it would be in the real-world. This means buildings, streets and landmarks as you would find them in real-life Barcelona must also exist in the game. As some of you may have already spotted, you can already find the La Sagrada Familia on the horizon when cruising the streets. We have also added in some new stuff like the Parc De la Ciutadella and Hivernacle del Parc de la Ciutadella, check it out: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/dd11acf1830d9b6d288d73d2fac1abd6a33c32b6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/764baf4d978b3aba3a3c60c1ab064cb78844dc1e.png

In addition, we’ve managed to set up a couple of POIs (Points of Interest) on the map, which directs our engine to adjust traffic, and then allows us to witness denser traffic in these areas at any given time. For example, there will be many more cars around the office districts during rush hour.

Bollards won’t be annoying anymore! 

Environmental destruction is a thing now in Urban Venture. For example, your vehicle can now knock down the bollards on the streets. While before they were made of solid steel… Now, you can simply run them over. Sadly, we don't have a video to show of this, due to some bugs on-going with the car, but we will share some imagery of this soon! 

Day And Night Cycle


This is something that a lot of people from the community have been asking about and we’re happy to say that we have implemented the first iteration of a Day/Night cycle in Urban Venture. There is not much more to say besides the fact that we will continue to make it better throughout the development process, like the time of day affecting traffic. In the meantime, see the outcome for yourself: 

[previewyoutube=o7wc8ggpUAY;full][/previewyoutube]

Gas Station Gameplay Mechanic

Since we started the development of Urban Venture we have been focused on creating the world of Barcelona on a 1:1 scale. This was a huge undertaking and now that we have generated most of the world, it’s time for us to start focusing on actual gameplay. One of the first gameplay mechanics we have added to Urban Venture is the gas station! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/6f1aa879c3172db9d85b7086fdc9dceed6ab76ef.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/278016e92038f868e15e5e1160cde106980a18fd.png

The player will be able to pull up to a pump, and fill gas up manually depending on the amount of money the player wants to spend, or you can automatically fill up the entire tank at once! At this moment, there are three gas stations you can find in Barcelona. In the future, we will be talking about charging your vehicles as we also want to add electric cars to the game as well! 

The Car Cabin


We’re also super excited to share with you all some of the in-car features that we have been teasing since the announcement of Urban Venture. We’ve talked about how the player will have full control of the vehicle's cabin as you would in real life, and here, you can finally see the progress we made. You can even roll the window down now with the press of a button! The navigation system has also been added and improved in the cabin.

[previewyoutube=a8o-CNmJ2B0;full][/previewyoutube]

Of course there is still some more functionality to be added to the button cabins and we will for sure share more details on that in the future!

Thanks for reading! 

We can’t thank the community enough for showing support for our games. We have been to SXSW (South By Southwest) and PAX East in the last few months and it was really great to see people's reactions when we showed what Urban Venture was about. The reaction online was also fantastic to experience.

We will keep you guys updated as time goes on and we will have another Dev Blog planned for you all soon! Make sure to follow us on all social media channels which you can find here, and make sure to join our Discord channel to chat with the developers!


Hasta La Próxima,

Aleksandra 
Urban Venture Producer

notes.title: Dev Blog #2 | Company history and the direction we're going in
notes.content:
Hello Drivers and Engineers! 

Welcome to our second blog post! We thought we might take a little bit of a different approach in this post and properly introduce ourselves to the community. We have some established fans from the Train Life community and now, with the development of Urban Venture, more and more people are coming to get to know us. 

We know you all are hungry for more information regarding Urban Venture as well as Train Life: A Railway Simulator (Trust us, we are eager to give it to you!) but we thought it would be cool to also take a step back, and give the community some insight on who we are and what we plan to achieve. We will be sharing more information regarding updates and news for both Urban Venture and Train Life in the near future. So, who doesn’t love a little bit of a back-story? Let’s dive right in! 

Get To Know Us

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/d39a6af8649300d187497df9899ac74b49e80d66.jpg

We started off as a software house in 2014 specializing in training simulations. Since then, we have been creating professional simulators, e.g. for trainees in the United States who were learning to drive real-life trains, and we used this as the basis for our business today.

After several years of hard work we gained the knowledge to create vast worlds and immersive simulators for the gaming community. We have specialists from all over the world and right now we’re about 70 people strong all having experience in the gaming industry and beyond. In our everyday work, we use modern equipment and in-house technology such as Traffic AI™ and City Generator, tools we use to make the games you see today and will make in the future. We’ll talk more about those in a bit!

We Make Premium Simulation Games

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/4b2ede90620d929f389f05915b8a5eb848c2047d.png

We’re an independent game-developer focusing on premium vehicle simulators. As you guys may know, we currently have 2 titles; Train Life: A Railway Simulator and Urban Venture. We value quality over quantity and we believe that gameplay is king. Our technologies let us implement scale & details easily, mapping real life cities and streets while also giving your fellow drivers on the road believable actions & reactions. With those taken care of we can focus on making sure the core foundation of our gameplay: the driving, the progression, and the exploration, all feel and work great.

It’s also very important for us that our games are available on all platforms - not just PC but also consoles. As we deal with COVID-19 and other difficulties, computers and technology have played a major role in our daily lives. We want to cater to people from all walks of life that play our games. From the hardcore sim fans with years of experience and an intricate simulator setup, to the casual player that just wants to relax after work. 

Let’s Talk Tech

We've developed two pieces of technology that we mentioned earlier in this blog, Traffic AI™ and City Generator. We use these technologies inside of our video games to bring players a fully immersive experience.

Traffic AI is an external library which places cars on virtual roads that behave just like they do in the real world. We have used this technology in real life autonomous vehicles to teach their intelligent algorithms. If you’re interested for more information, feel free to check out this link. 

[previewyoutube=gQxyweSfQzM;full][/previewyoutube]

City Generator is an advanced tool that allows us to instantly create virtual environments in 3D, ready to be implemented into any game engine. We use OSM (Open Street Maps) data to automatically create and generate cities where we can go back and make edits and changes as necessary. You can learn more about how we do this, by checking out the video we made describing this process in some more detail. 

[previewyoutube=iiHCNpoMZq0;full][/previewyoutube]

With that, we think that’s about it from our side! We wanted to give you a bit of background and share a bit of our roots before we start to dive into sharing the development of Urban Venture. We’re happy to be part of the community and you guys have shown us a great amount of passion for the games we make. In turn, this gives us the motivation and focus to bring you guys games that you will play for hundreds, if not thousands of hours in the future. Without the community, we wouldn’t be in the position we’re in today. Thank you. 

Stay tuned for more, there is much to be done!

Mike 
Simteract Community Manager

notes.title: Urban Venture | Dev Blog #1
notes.content:
Hello Drivers!

Welcome to our first developer blog for Urban Venture! We’re very excited to talk about some of the things we have been working on and what is to come in the future for Urban Venture. 

Please keep in mind however, that everything that we talk about in this dev blog is subject to change! Game development is an on-going process of iteration and experimentation. Everything is a work in progress, and may be changed completely by the launch of Early Access. 

With that in mind, hopefully we will answer some of the questions or concerns you might have about the development process, so without further ado, let's get into it.

Features

We’re going to have many features in Urban Venture like realistic driving physics, a 1:1 recreation of a 20 km2 scaled city of Barcelona, and much more. We’ll be exploring a variety of features in these posts, but want to highlight a few that we’ve been working on recently:

Story Arcs

Story arcs and NPC dialog minigames are going to play a big role in Urban Venture, which will influence the amount of experience and money gained from a job. You’ll be engaging your rider in conversation and making dialog choices as you get from Point A to Point B. This means depending on your responses and the customer’s requests, your rider’s sentiment and attitude can shift positively or negatively during the ride.

Here is one example of a WIP dialog exchange with a client:

[previewyoutube=zM9sBl5VcsI;full][/previewyoutube]

But, this is not a “one and done” thing! Let's say you finish a conversation with a client, and you meet the same client again moving forward. You can continue the conversation and see what the outcome of their story arc is. Right now, this feature needs some more polish, but the content above gives you a good idea in the direction we’re going in.

Quick-Look

Awareness of your surroundings is something that plays a big part in Urban Venture. We want to make the player aware of what is going on the streets of Barcelona just as you would need to be aware in real life. This brought us a challenging question; How will we help the player become more aware of his/her surroundings without blocking the line of sight by the vehicle's design? 

For example, when you pull up to an intersection and you have to lean forward to see when the light will switch. We understand that this isn’t really an issue in the US, but in the EU, with our tiny cars and tiny streets, this definitely is!

We remedied this by implementing a quick-look/camera-lean feature that you can see in this example:

[previewyoutube=AnefezJU6IU;full][/previewyoutube]

This took some work, but we believe it will help with immersion of playing the game and help the player be more aware of their surroundings. In third-person this won't be needed as you can just move the camera around according to your needs, but since we are making a simulation game, players that are looking for a “as close to realistic experience as possible,” will find this a welcome mechanic when driving the car in first-person. 

Vehicle Damage and Maintenance  


While you won’t be checking cars off the roads for takedowns, we do want vehicle damage to be something to consider and avoid while driving in Urban Venture.

Vehicle damage will have an influence on how your passengers react to you or how your vehicle performs on the roads. For a proper immersive experience, we’re experimenting with a destruction model generated by Houdini’s procedural system to allow the vehicle to react to the environment as naturally as possible (feel free to see our video on how we use Houdini to procedurally generate the worlds we create). Right now, we’re just testing specific points of damage on the player's vehicle.  

The player will be able to customize and maintain their vehicle using the garage that will be available in the game sometime around Early Access launch or beyond. As we get closer to the launch, we will share some more information on that.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/548ada86ae8a3c0493df81d24fbdea593954ae58.png

Radial Menu

Since we’re on the topic of car service and NPC interaction, we needed a way for the player to easily maneuver around the HUD and interact with the vehicle as fluidly as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42073432/80e0dd44e6ff0516079f530e7fa3e8cab5681851.png

We’ve mocked up a quick version of a radial menu that we’re planning on adding into the game. This is just our first version and we’re still not sure if we will actually use this method for the game. Overall though, we think it gives the player choices on how to interact with the vehicle ranging from opening or closing passenger windows or turning the wipers on/off upon the client’s request when playing with a regular gamepad.

That’s it for our first blog post!  As you can see, we’re actively working on a lot of features for the game, and we hope you like what you see so far. Stay up to date with the latest news from Urban Venture by following Simteract on social media, as well as joining the official Discord where you can talk with the developers directly!

We really appreciate all the love for the game we’ve been getting from the community so far, you guys are the best and we hope you’ll stick around and see what we have baking in the oven for the future 😉.

Hasta la próxima,

Aleksandra
Urban Venture Producer
